en: ZZ version, Zusa is here! !
Zusa, who appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", has been commercialized in the 1/144 Scale HGUC series, perfect for collection.
Zusa when ZZ appeared is reproduced with molded colors and new parts!
● Forearm shape reproduction!
The forearm, which has a different shape from the unicorn version, is reproduced with new modeling.
● The main unit is fully equipped, including missiles deployed in various locations as a medium-range attack MS.
● Booster pod can be separated.
Attached weapon: Beam saber
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
